rationale: Reallocates export precision within the proven staged reverse-tail baseline: the final recurrent block now keeps its MLP expansion matrix in fp16, while penultimate tail Q/K fp16 rescue is removed. The final block is always full-gain and closest to the logits, so preserving its nonlinear MLP input projection should better survive the exact int8+zlib roundtrip without adding compute or intermediate validation, and the byte trade stays under the 16 MB cap.
title: Final Recurrent Block MLP FP16 Reallocation
